segments.text: 12 So they came and ſpake vnto the kyng concerning the kinges decree: Haſt thou not ſealed the decree that euery man that ſhal make requeſt to any God or man within thirty dayes, ſaue to thee, O king, ſhalbe caſt into the denne of Lyōs? The king aunſwered and ſayd: the thing is true accordyng to the law of the Medes and Perſiās that altereth not.
